name: agent-blockhall
description: Agent Blockhall's free Bitcoin catalogue for AI agents: blocks, every transaction in a block sorted and checked, inscriptions and proof of where they came from, alerts when things happen, trails and fee advice that keeps score of itself.
long_description: Agent Blockhall is a 3D Bitcoin block explorer world for players and agents (https://bitmap22.github.io/my-ordinal-portal/block-cube.html). This tool gives AI agents its catalogue without a browser: the chain now, the big screen's fee advice (it says how often it would have been right), every inscription made in a block, every transaction in a block sorted into the halls' kinds and checked (the Block Manifest), inscriptions with their parents and children, proof of where an inscription came from with every step checked (the Provenance Check), alerts when something happens on the chain (Watch), an inscription's trail back to where it was made, the tablet's search and the rare sats board. It is always free. It runs on your computer, needs no keys or accounts, and reads free public sites (mempool.space and its copies, ordpool.space, ordinals.com and its back-ups) gently, with back-ups if one is down.

tools.name: about
tools.description: What Agent Blockhall is, where to open it, and how agents use it in a browser.

tools.name: chain
tools.description: Bitcoin right now: the newest block, the last blocks mined, the blocks waiting and the next halving.

tools.name: feeAdvice
tools.description: The big screen's fee advice: usual wait, best time to get in, and fees worked out from the last day of blocks, with how often it would have been right.

tools.name: block
tools.description: A block by its number: hash, time, size, transactions and every inscription made in it.

tools.name: blockManifest
tools.description: Every transaction in a block, sorted into the halls' kinds (inscriptions, bitmaps, BRC-20, runes, Alkanes, Stamps, CAT-21 and more), with fee and size, each one checked against a second site, ordpool.space's tags and ordinals.com.

tools.name: inscription
tools.description: An inscription by number or ID: what it is, where it was made, its sat, who holds it, its parents and children.

tools.name: provenanceCheck
tools.description: Proof of where an inscription came from: read from its own transaction's bytes, its content fingerprinted, its block, number and sat checked with second sites, and every move followed back to where it was made.

tools.name: children
tools.description: The children of a parent inscription (a collection), a page at a time.

tools.name: followBack
tools.description: Follow an inscription back to where it was made and each place it moved.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Alerts when something happens on the chain, each checked: the next block, a fee level, an inscription moving, an address, or a kind of transaction in a new block. Carries a since token between calls.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a block, bitmap, parcel, inscription, transaction or address, as the tablet does.

tools.name: rareSats
tools.description: The rare sats board: each kind of rare sat and the price listed for one sat.
